- tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py: lines 28-35, 46-47 | severity=low | confidence=3

  WHY: The guard can pass CI while the test remains untested.
- TASK_GAP

  Expected change site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml at three env blocks where the sibling vars AUTO_MERGE_CHECKS_WAIT_MINUTES and AUTO_MERGE_CHECKS_POLL_SECONDS are already exported: deterministic-skip-merge job around line 2109-2110; codex-agent step around line 5377-5379; review-blocked judge step around line 5552-5554.

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py: 30-35 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The workflow wiring check incorrectly counts paths appearing in inline comments as wired tests.
  WHY: CI may report that a test is wired when it is only mentioned in a comment, causing CI to pass while omitting actual test execution.
- scripts/ci_budget_watch.py: 193-196 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The script attempts to label issues with `ai:ci-budget` without ensuring the label exists.
  WHY: Issues are not filed on repositories where the label has not been manually created, so budget-watch alerts may be lost.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The PR describes AUTO_MERGE_WAIT_WORKFLOWS as configurable, with CI as the default and none, off, or empty disabling the wait.
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml (the steps that call _pr_wait_for_required_checks)
  Evidence of absence: The review workflow does not pass the AUTO_MERGE_WAIT_WORKFLOWS repository variable to the script process, so it only ever uses the hardcoded default "CI".
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py: 46-47 | severity=low | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `_is_wired` treats any occurrence of a test path in workflow text as proof that the test runs.
  WHY: A path mentioned only in an inline comment or descriptive workflow text passes the guard even when no workflow step executes that test, leaving it unwired without a CI failure.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: “While any run of a workflow named in `AUTO_MERGE_WAIT_WORKFLOWS` (default `CI`) is not completed, it keeps waiting”; the PR describes this setting as configurable.
  Expected change site: `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` and `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml`, in the environments used by callers of `_pr_wait_for_required_checks`.
  Evidence of absence: The PR diff adds the setting to the helper and documents it, but neither workflow exports `AUTO_MERGE_WAIT_WORKFLOWS` from `vars`. Repository variables are not automatically environment variables, so overrides are ignored and callers always use the helper’s default.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
  SEVERITY: NIT
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml: lines 2109, 5378, 5553 (env blocks that forward AUTO_MERGE_CHECKS_WAIT_MINUTES but not AUTO_MERGE_WAIT_WORKFLOWS) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The workflow does not forward the documented `AUTO_MERGE_WAIT_WORKFLOWS` repository variable to the helper process.
  WHY: Operators setting `vars.AUTO_MERGE_WAIT_WORKFLOWS` to `"CI, Build"` or `"none"` see no behavior change; the merge gate always waits for workflow runs named `"CI"` and nothing else.
- scripts/ci_budget_watch.py: line 40 (LABEL = "ai:ci-budget"), lines 193-196 (issue creation with labels: [LABEL]) | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `ai:ci-budget` is not declared in `.github/ai/label_contract.v1.json`, so label sync and contract validation do not manage it.
  WHY: If the `CI_BUDGET_ISSUE_TOKEN` lacks label-creation permission, issue creation is rejected and the exception at lines 199-200 silently swallows the failure, so no budget issue is filed.
- tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py: lines 30-35 (_workflow_text strips full-line comments), line 46 (_is_wired substring check) | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The guard retains inline comments and uses substring matching, so a test path mentioned only in an inline comment can count as wired.
  WHY: The guard can pass while the test remains unwired in CI.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The PR description and README describe AUTO_MERGE_WAIT_WORKFLOWS as a configurable repo var with default "CI" and "none"/"off"/empty to disable.
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml env blocks at lines 2109, 5378, 5553 (alongside AUTO_MERGE_CHECKS_WAIT_MINUTES), and .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml where pr_checks_lib.sh is sourced for the final merge gate.
  Evidence of absence: grep for AUTO_MERGE_WAIT_WORKFLOWS across all .github/workflows/*.yml files returns zero matches; the variable is never forwarded from vars to the step env, so the helper always uses its hardcoded default "CI".
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
